label: Coder
description: Stateless prompt-driven agent invoked through a CLI.
fullDescription: This agent is responsible for writing code based on a set of requirements. It can read task descriptions and design documents, and it writes code files and a summary of its work.
promptTemplate: Use the CLI in non-interactive mode to complete the current pipeline stage. Your task is to write code based on the provided inputs. After modifications, also write a human-readable summary of what you changed into implementation.diff.md. Include any assumptions and list the files changed.
